sentences.sentence_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to industrialize governed agentic AI, turning control-plane architecture and disciplined delivery operations into a productized commercial engine for regulated enterprise clients, with reusable IP and partner-enabled adoption extending from bespoke engagements to repeatable deployment pathways.
